people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Serug; father of Terah, Abraham's father.

people.name: Serug
people.line: Son of Reu; father of Nahor, ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
translations.bsb: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
